new.s: The first Lokpal Bill of 1968 was introduced during which Lok Sabha?
new.x: The first Lokpal Bill was introduced in 1968 in the 4th Lok Sabha; it lapsed when that House was dissolved.
new.angle: U0349 #1/#9 First Lokpal Bill -> year, House (APPSC PYQ ydb3f46905c1)

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the first Lokpal Bill:
1. It was introduced in the Lok Sabha in 1968.
2. It was passed by both Houses of Parliament in 1969.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Bill was introduced in 1968 and passed only by the Lok Sabha in 1969; it lapsed before the Rajya Sabha passed it.
new.angle: U0349 #1/#9 First Lokpal Bill -> introduced vs passed (APPSC PYQ ydb3f46905c1)

new.s: On which date did the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 receive the President's assent?

new.s: The Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 came into force on 16 January 2014. Which event relating to the Act took place on 1 January 2014?

new.angle: U0349 #2/#10 Lokpal Act -> assent vs commencement (APPSC PYQ y83f2f91265e)

new.s:

1. President's assent
2. Passage by the Lok Sabha

new.x: Rajya Sabha passed it on 17 Dec 2013, Lok Sabha on 18 Dec 2013, assent came on 1 Jan 2014 and it came into force on 16 Jan 2014.
